snippet.title: Ribbit Jump - Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
A precision platformer where every move counts. Adjust the power of each jump to progress through increasingly demanding level designs. Conquer 50 obstacle-filled levels and master every leap across diverse environments.

Get Ribbit Jump on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4284830/Ribbit_Jump/
